title: `OwnableUpgradeable` uses single-step ownership transfer
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Low, because it requires an error on the admin side  **Impact:** High, because important protocol functionality will be bricked  ## Description  Single-step ownership transfer means that if a wrong address was passed when transferring ownership or admin rights it can mean that role is lost forever. The ownership pattern implementation for the protocol is in `OwnableUpgradeable.sol` where a single-step transfer is implemented.This can be a problem for all methods marked in `onlyOwner` throughout the protocol, some of which are core protocol functionality.  ## Recomm
